english.note: Use 麻煩 for the figurative sense of being in trouble or a difficult situation.

exampleSentences.english: I'm really in a pickle this time—I lost my passport.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今次真係跌入麻煩喇，份護照唔見咗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 dit3 jap6 maa4 faan4 laa3 fan2 wu6 ziu3 m4 gin3 zo2

english.note: Use this for being in a difficult situation or for extra inconvenience; in a legal context it can mean being in trouble with the authorities without naming the legal issue.

exampleSentences.english: We’re in trouble this time—the police arrested us.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋今次麻煩喇，俾警察拉咗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 maa4 faan4 laa3 bei2 ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2

english.note: Use this colloquially when the predicament is described as trouble or an immediate problem.

exampleSentences.english: The car has broken down in the middle of nowhere, and we are really in a predicament now.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部車喺荒山野嶺死火，我哋今次真係麻煩喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 ce1 hai2 fong1 saan1 je5 leng5 sei2 fo2 ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4 laa3

english.note: Use this for being in trouble or having a difficult situation to deal with.

exampleSentences.english: We’re really in a jam this time—the document has gone missing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋今次真係麻煩喇，份文件唔見咗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 maa4 faan4 laa3 fan6 man4 gin6 m4 gin3 zo2
